text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: One of the people debuting today, Air Shakur, is apparently pretty scary. They say she's super smart, but also suuuper anti-social.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Really? I had no idea there was someone
like that
at Tracen Academy. But she
does sound
interesting. I'm gonna look
out for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur finishes some final checks on
her PC
and then abruptly closes her
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by
extraneous
noise. If you let every little
thing distract you,
there'll be no end to
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think she's blocking out the noise
around her so
she can sharpen her focus.
I should avoid talking
to her right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Parcae predicts that no matter how I do
in my
debut race, I'll be on track for two
crowns.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same whether I win or lose.
Perfect.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This is a chance to check Parcae's
accuracy. Are
their predictions wrong?
Or undeniable?)
